comment: Source read at commit 21bfcbf, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.0. The rate law (24.995 V + 250.05, PolyLFT.cpp:48) is not clamped, so a voltage outside ±10V runs past the knob's own 0.1 to 500 range. Min and Max are only the two ends of the wave: setting Min above Max turns the triangle upside down rather than doing nothing.
